title: FondueQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Parametric Compensation in Multi-Hop QA
abstract: arXiv:2611.09274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable performance based on parametric knowledge, i.e., their ability to recall facts and associations internalized in a model's weights. However, studying this capability on established multi-hop benchmarks may be complicated by benchmark contamination, as many of these benchmarks have been publicly available long enough to plausibly appear in modern pretraining corpora. As a result, correct answers under missing evidence may reflect either general parametric knowledge or memorization of benchmark-specific instances. To study how models use internal knowledge when retrieval evidence is incomplete, we introduce FondueQA, in which every required multi-hop fact is uniquely localized to a designated evidence document. translated_title: FondueQA：用于评估多跳问答中参数化补偿能力的基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）展现出基于参数化知识的卓越性能，即其能够回忆起内化在模型权重中的事实与关联。然而，在现有的多跳问答基准上研究这一能力可能会受到基准污染的干扰，因为许多此类基准已公开发布很长时间，很可能已出现在现代预训练语料库中。因此，在证据缺失情况下给出的正确答案，可能反映的是模型的一般参数化知识，也可能是对基准特定实例的记忆。为了研究模型在检索证据不完整时如何利用内部知识，我们提出了FondueQA，其中每个所需的多跳事实都被唯一地定位到指定的证据文档。这使得我们可以进行受控的文档级证据消融，以研究在不完整检索条件下的参数化补偿。我们的实证评估表明，参数化补偿能力……
tldr: 提出FondueQA基准，通过将每个多跳事实唯一映射到指定证据文档并执行受控的文档级证据消融，评估大语言模型在不完整检索下利用内部参数化知识进行补偿的能力，同时避免基准污染问题。
en_tdlr: Introduces FondueQA, a benchmark in which every required multi-hop fact is uniquely localized to a designated evidence document, enabling controlled document-level evidence ablations to evaluate LLMs' parametric compensation under incomplete retrieval while avoiding benchmark contamination.
